verdict.rationale: The Railway Agent is a chat-based AI assistant built into the dashboard. It inspects deployments, diagnoses failures, reads logs, and suggests fixes by opening pull requests, which gives AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's project data inside the product; it is also reachable via Slack. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive or unprompted insights, AI analysis of metrics and dashboard data beyond deployments and logs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent's diagnostic quality.
